description: NYC Survive is a colony sim set in a besieged Times Square. Manage colonists, build shelters and defenses, and keep your people alive through the night. Fully player-controlled: no autoplay, no idle timers — every move is yours.
promotionalText: Times Square has gone dark. Command your survivors, build shelter and defenses, and keep them fed, rested and breathing. No autopilot: every move is yours.
